SPECIMEN :    Kidney biopsy: Electron Microscopy

GROSS    :    Received 1 linear core measuring 1.0 cm & 1 paraffin block labelled as 14399/24 for EM studies. [EM:24-G- 335]

ELECTRON MICROSCOPY : No glomeruli were seen in tissue sent for EM studies. Remnant tissue on paraffin block was reprocessed for transmission electron microscopy and ultrathin sections were stained with uranyl acetate and lead citrate. A partial capillary tuft was available for evaluation. Paraffin artefacts are noted.

Diffuse effacement of foot processes of visceral epithelial cells is noted. Several subepithelial electron dense deposits are identified, which do not show definite substructure on examination at high magnification. Focal microvillous change of terminal processes of visceral epithelial cells is noted.

Few tubules show confluent electron lucent vacuolar inclusions in cytoplasm. Extraglomerular electron dense deposits are not seen

IMPRESSION :  Kidney, electron microscopy:

1. Subepithelial electron dense deposits. No substructure is identified in the deposits.

2. Diffuse effacement of visceral epithelial cell foot processes.

COMMENTS :    

The ultrastructural features are consistent with a stage 2 membranous nephropathy. Please correlate with clinical features and results of relevant investigative parameters.

NOTE:

1. All controls show appropriate reactivity.
2. Type of specimen fixation & processing – Formalin fixed paraffin embedded tissue.
3. Detection system used is Polymer HRP.
4. The impression is based on the material submitted and is not a complete renal pathology report.
5. False negative IHC results due to inadequate fixation of the material sent for evaluation cannot be excluded

FIXATION REQUIREMENTS:

The volume of formalin fixative should be at least 10 times the volume of the specimen.
Specimen should be immersed in fixative within 1 hour of the biopsy (time of removal & time of immersion to be mentioned)
